# v0.16

Released 2026-11-15.

## Highlights

- A settings dialog and settings file, a multi-account rider picker, and a graphics probe
  under the profile selector.
- The launcher inhibits the screensaver while fullscreen and adapts download concurrency to
  the link; download rate is shown on the progress bar.
- An opt-in BLE connection-interval override for faster heart-rate data, gated on the
  `bluetooth-control` interface.
- The i386 Wine build was dropped and the Wine prerequisites are installed natively.
